1) * grid_pitch + pocket_diameter\n    depth = 2 * margin + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch + pocket_diameter\n\n    # Create base block\n    base = box(width, depth, total_height)\n\n    # Create and subtract pockets (cylinders going from top to base)\n    pocket_radius = pocket_diameter / 2.0\n\n    for col in range(columns):\n        for row in range(rows):\n            # Calculate pocket center position\n            x = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n            y = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n\n            # Create pocket cylinder with flat bottom\n            pocket = cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth)\n            # Position cylinder: move to (x, y) and position its bottom at height 3.0\n            pocket = move(pocket, [x - pocket_radius, y - pocket_radius, total_height - pocket_depth])\n\n            # Subtract pocket from base\n            base = difference(base, pocket)\n\n    # Chamfer top face edges (top perimeter) and pocket mouths\n    # Select top face and chamfer its edges\n    base = base.faces.top.chamfer(size=chamfer_size)\n\n    # Chamfer pocket mouth edges (the circular edges created by the subtractions)\n    # These are naturally selected as the edges between the top face and the pockets\n\n    return base\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":3,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":["+from nurb import *","+","+"," @part"," def bit_block(shank_diameter: float = 6.0, columns: int = 5):","     \"\"\"Driver bit holder block with upright pockets for driver bits."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

1) * grid_pitch + pocket_diameter\n24\t    depth = 2 * margin + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch + pocket_diameter\n25\t\n26\t    # Create base block (centered at origin)\n27\t    base = Box(width, depth, total_height)\n28\t\n29\t    # Create and subtract pockets (cylinders going from top to base)\n30\t    pocket_radius = pocket_diameter / 2.0\n31\t\n32\t    for col in range(columns):\n33\t        for row in range(rows):\n34\t            # Calculate pocket center position in original coordinate system (0 to width, 0 to depth)\n35\t            x_orig = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n36\t            y_orig = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n37\t\n38\t            # Adjust for centered box coordinate system\n39\t            # Box is centered, so it goes from -width/2 to width/2, -depth/2 to depth/2, -height/2 to height/2\n40\t            x_centered = x_orig - width / 2\n41\t            y_centered = y_orig - depth / 2\n42\t            z_centered = total_height / 2 - pocket_depth / 2\n43\t\n44\t            # Create pocket cylinder with base at z=3.0, top at z=15.0\n45\t            pocket = Cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth)\n46\t            # Move to center position in the centered coordinate system\n47\t            pocket = pocket.move(Location((x_centered, y_centered, z_centered)))\n48\t\n49\t            # Subtract pocket from base\n50\t            base -= pocket\n51\t\n52\t    # Keep bottom edges sharp, chamfer everything else\n53\t    bottom_z = 0.0\n54\t    keep_edges = base.edges().filter_by(lambda e: e.bounding_box().min.Z > bottom_z + 0.01)\n55\t\n56\t    base = polish(base, keep_edges, chamfer_size)\n57\t\n58\t    return base\n59\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9072dd7b-c84a-40bd-a6aa-0dd1088503c9","uuid":"b9161e2c-2afe-4fc5-920e-9737041181d6","timestamp":"2026-08-24T00:39:33.108Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"/private/var/folders/s4/by90nw7j7_l_nvvqs3hd9mjh0000gn/T/nurb-eval-trial-jl7k3d3m/project/parts/bit_block.py","content":"from nurb import *\n\n\n@part\ndef bit_block(shank_diameter: float = 6.0, columns: int = 5):\n    \"\"\"Driver bit holder block with upright pockets for driver bits.\n\n    shank_diameter: diameter of the driver bit shank in mm\n    columns: number of columns in the grid (default 5 for 5x2 layout)\n    \"\"\"\n    # Derived parameters from requirements\n    pocket_diameter = shank_diameter + 0.3\n    pocket_depth = 12.0\n    total_height = 15.0\n    chamfer_size = 0.8\n\n    # Grid parameters\n    grid_pitch = pocket_diameter + 2.0  # Pocket diameter + 2mm gap\n    margin = 2.0  # Margin from outer edge to pocket edge\n    rows = 2\n\n    # Calculate block dimensions to match requirements exactly\n    width = 2 * margin + (columns - 1) * grid_pitch + pocket_diameter\n    depth = 2 * margin + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch + pocket_diameter\n\n    # Create base block (centered at origin)\n    base = Box(width, depth, total_height)\n\n    # Create and subtract pockets (cylinders going from top to base)\n    pocket_radius = pocket_diameter / 2.0\n\n    for col in range(columns):\n        for row in range(rows):\n            # Calculate pocket center position in original coordinate system (0 to width, 0 to depth)\n            x_orig = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n            y_orig = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n\n            # Adjust for centered box coordinate system\n            # Box is centered, so it goes from -width/2 to width/2, -depth/2 to depth/2, -height/2 to height/2\n            x_centered = x_orig - width / 2\n            y_centered = y_orig - depth / 2\n            z_centered = total_height / 2 - pocket_depth / 2\n\n            # Create pocket cylinder with base at z=3.0, top at z=15.0\n            pocket = Cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth)\n            # Move to center position in the centered coordinate system\n            pocket = pocket.move(Location((x_centered, y_centered, z_centered)))\n\n            # Subtract pocket from base\n            base -= pocket\n\n    # Keep bottom edges sharp, chamfer everything else\n    bottom_z = 0.0\n    keep_edges = base.edges().filter_by(lambda e: e.bounding_box().min.Z > bottom_z + 0.01)\n\n    base = polish(base, keep_edges, chamfer_size)\n\n    return base\n","numLines":59,"startLine":1,"totalLines":59}}}
